summary: Iteration_3 regression testing of the media upscale (WebP+AVIF @800/1600/2400 + hero-poster @3200), new landhaus.mp4/webm, Landhaus reference video wiring, ReferenceFeature card + Arezen glass-overlay-in-3D-Twin, and content-type-guarded scaffolding. Backend: 61/61 pytest tests passed (all new assets served with image/* content-types across 800/1600/2400 widths per family, hero-poster additionally at 3200 for both formats; hero.mp4<=8MB, hero.webm OK, dachwohnung.mp4<=3MB, landhaus.mp4=1'583'090B (~1.51MB) <=5MB with video/mp4, landhaus.webm=1'647'389B (~1.57MB) <6MB; old hero-*/hero.png paths return HTML/404; GET /api/listings returns 7 with Landhaus title starting with 'Totalsanierung historisches Landhaus', video_url=/media/landhaus.mp4, highlight=true; valuation LLM produces German commentary with min<=expected<=max; inquiries persist; admin auth (correct/wrong pw) works; chat SSE streams German deltas and terminates with type:'done'; frontend HTML free of '15 Jahre' claims). Frontend Playwright verified: Hero DOM has AVIF containing hero-poster-{800,1600,2400,3200}.avif AND WebP containing hero-poster-{800,1600,2400,3200}.webp; present. Crest testids (crest-header/hero/trust/footer) are all ABSENT in the DOM (as expected, /brand/wappen.png missing → content-type guard returns nothing); Header still renders SVG house icon inside a[data-testid='brand-link']. Referenzen tab (data-testid='objekte-tab-reference') reveals data-testid='reference-feature' containing a for landhaus and a desktop

minor.issue: Body validation still runs before admin-password check (returns 422 without header). Carried from previous iterations.

issues: Submitting with default/empty area+rooms still allows LLM to return negative CHF (observed -2'180). Same known issue from iteration_2 — cosmetic; disable val-submit or require sane defaults.

action_items: (Optional, carried) Prevent Bewertung val-submit with zero/empty area & rooms.
(Optional, carried) Reorder POST /api/listings to check X-Admin-Password before Pydantic validation.
critical_code_review_comments: Crest content-type guard (r.headers.get('content-type').startsWith('image/')) correctly defeats the SPA catch-all that returns text/html — no crest-* elements in DOM while /brand/wappen.png is missing. Good defensive design.
Header.jsx correctly conditions the SVG house icon fallback on !hasCrest (verified: SVG visible while crest missing).
Objekte.jsx ReferenceFeature and ArezenOverlayVideo isolate hover state; DigitalTwin canvas is NOT unmounted on hover — good, avoids WebGL context churn.
Hero now advertises full 800/1600/2400/3200 srcset for both AVIF and WebP; preserved.
Media file sizes are within budget: hero-poster-800.avif=17'894B, hero-poster-1600.webp=86'588B, landhaus.mp4=1.51MB, landhaus.webm=1.57MB.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (parametrised full 3-width WebP + 2-width AVIF matrix for 7 asset families incl. hero-poster @3200; added landhaus.mp4/.webm size+ctype checks; added Landhaus listing highlight+video_url+title assertions; added HEAD test for hero-poster-3200.webp; added perf_sizes reporting test)
